recommendation: Keep the core audit commit. Follow up in HL7/kindling, especially TableGenerator.java, to move and relabel the inherited-element list for resource and datatype table renderings, then rebuild FHIR core once the publisher change is available.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core issue asking generated structure tables to move inherited Resource/DomainResource elements out of the root row description column, relabel them as inherited elements not included below, and apply the same treatment to datatype pages inheriting Element elements.
initial_application: Jira records an application note GH#dbe102bb95, but no matching current HL7/fhir commit or GitHub commit was found. Current rendered build pages still show the old Elements defined in Ancestors wording in the Description & Constraints cell, so the requested rendering behavior is not complete in the current publication surface.
additional_context: FHIR-18335 was the related ballot issue resolved no-change as out of ballot scope, and FHIR-I minutes show it spawned FHIR-19304 for the rendering change. The current FHIR build uses org.hl7.fhir:kindling and runs org.hl7.fhir.tools.publisher.Publisher; HL7/kindling TableGenerator.java still emits the old ancestor wording in the root row description cell. Zulip publisher discussion also identifies ancestor display as publisher-owned behavior.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No core source was changed because patching local generated-looking snippets or a single resource note would not address the all-resource/all-datatype generated renderer behavior requested by the issue.

related_jiras.note: Original ballot comment for the same DomainResource inheritance visibility concern; resolved no-change as out of ballot scope and explicitly pointed to FHIR-19304. Not decided because it is a resolved-no-change precursor outside this seed's source-edit scope.
